column1: # Folded skill names and their successors.
# ADR-038 consolidated the catalog; a name whose directory no longer exists is
# dead routing. An agent told to "invoke `triz-analysis`" gets nothing, because
# that skill is not there any more.

# column and fails, which is what LESSON-036 asked for and never got: it listed
# the doc locations a merge must touch, but nothing verified them.
